body:
The five Dependabot PRs linked from #25 conflict with the newer model and lockfile migrations on main. This PR carries every requested update forward, refreshes all dependency ecosystems against current registries, and fixes the actual stale-test and security failures without restoring obsolete pins.

Fixes #25

- Update Python build/dev/docs/model dependencies and transitive locks, all six Terraform provider locks, infrastructure/download/image/chart pins, pre-commit hooks, and all 26 GitHub Actions repositories. Synchronize repeated pins and add locked infrastructure/Azure CLI environments. Add a changelog fragment for the existing release workflow.
- Replace copied rotary initialization with native Transformers Qwen2 config/embedding, replace manual causal masking with PyTorch's native bias, and replace GKE's deprecated temporary default pool with the provider's zero-node setting. Preserve golden model outputs and existing compatibility paths.
- Run current Python 3.15.2 and Node 26.13.0; isolate model/Ansible Python at 3.14.10 for documented upstream support limits. Lock secretlint and the native pnpm 12.16.1 manager; the rejected npm bundle candidate had unresolved bundled advisories. Cover all six Terraform roots and the new manifests with Dependabot.

Full [requirement-by-requirement analysis and solution alternatives](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-25-4d7bfe8dca13/dev/log/issues/25/pulls/26/requirements.md), [every-dependency before/current/latest tables and explicit holds](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-25-4d7bfe8dca13/dev/log/issues/25/pulls/26/versions.md), [migration/component research](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-25-4d7bfe8dca13/dev/log/issues/25/pulls/26/research.md), [CI root causes with preserved log lines](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-25-4d7bfe8dca13/dev/log/issues/25/pulls/26/ci-investigation.md), and [validation evidence](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-25-4d7bfe8dca13/dev/log/issues/25/pulls/26/validation.md) are collected in [dev/log/issues/25/pulls/26](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/blob/issue-25-4d7bfe8dca13/dev/log/issues/25/pulls/26). Registry snapshots and reusable bounded reproductions are included. Exact upstream parent/ABI bounds and supported cloud/OS channels are documented per dependency; no advisory exclusions were added.

Validation:

- Full local suite: **1,119 passed, 48 skipped**, 96% source coverage; real upstream UniMedVL CPU tests: **10 passed, one CUDA-only skip**, with unchanged golden tokens/logits and FutureWarning treated as error.
- Ruff, formatting, both strict mypy surfaces, all pre-commit hooks, package build/install/metadata, warnings-as-errors Sphinx, and repository policy checks pass.
- All six Terraform roots, TFLint, production Ansible lint, rendered Kubernetes/Helm schemas, ShellCheck, actionlint and online zizmor pass. Frozen scanner install/scan and all Python/JavaScript dependency audits pass with **zero known advisories and zero exclusions**.
- All eight workflows pass on final commit `5d4429e`: 38 successful checks, 11 expected conditional skips, zero failures or pending checks ([final check list](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/pull/26/checks)). Hosted tests include real sample downloads, upstream CPU model code, MedGemma CPU inference/server, OCR, kind/container integration and native macOS audits. Final [security](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/actions/runs/41090196466) and [model](https://github.com/konard/medical-neural-network-ml/actions/runs/41090196475) runs verify this exact head.

Reproduce the original failures with the saved historical Dependabot logs or the pre-fix Terraform-coverage/GKE regression test logs. `experiments/issue25_unimedvl_migration.py` reproduces the old config warning and current CPU missing-kernel behavior; the native config and retained CPU fallback then pass. `experiments/issue25_sentencepiece_wheels.py` verifies the released Python-wheel limit. Physical GPU/cloud provisioning and write-capable release jobs retain their existing trusted-main/manual conditions; no physical GPU run is claimed.

Upstream reports, searched before reporting and containing current affected versions, bounded reproductions, local workarounds and proposed changes:

- [UniMedVL hard imports and native Qwen2 migration](https://github.com/uni-medical/UniMedVL/issues/10#issuecomment-6527128930)
- [PyTorch variable-length CPU fallback](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/issues/201457#issuecomment-6527129521)
- [SentencePiece released cp315 wheels](https://github.com/google/sentencepiece/issues/1357#issuecomment-6527130129)
- [npm bundled dependencies and ineffective audit fixes](https://github.com/npm/cli/issues/10163#issuecomment-6527130829)
- [Existing Dependabot coupled-input update report, revalidated with current uv](https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/issues/16390)
- [Existing actionlint queue syntax report](https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/issues/654)
- [Existing actionlint hosted-runner catalog report](https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/issues/682)
title: Update all dependencies and replace obsolete model adapters
